Swift Response. Daring Rescue. A Family Reunited.

A life was saved this morning at Budge Budge Ferry Ghat when Sgt. Sandip Roy of the Budge Budge Ferry Ghat Outpost spotted a man being swept south by the strong current of the River Hooghly during a routine area patrol.

He acted quickly, seeking help from local boatmen. Together, they intercepted the drifting man and brought him to safety near Jetty No. 1. The rescued man was immediately taken to Budge Budge Municipal Hospital for urgent medical treatment.

Following a prompt local enquiry and coordination, he was identified and reunited with his son.

Swift action and timely teamwork turned a moment of crisis into a life brought to safety and a family brought back together.
